nodes.rationale: sending is committed before the external call; interrupted rows are never auto-retried to avoid duplicate posts.

nodes.rationale: A processor works one item at a time and cannot rate-limit across items; superseded since remix should be side-effect free.

nodes.label: Derived vs recorded data distinction

nodes.rationale: Dates play no part so sources without dates are not reimported every run.

nodes.label: Item identity (source id, uid)
nodes.rationale: Each source is its own uid space; provider's uid derivation is its own choice. uri is data, not identity.

nodes.label: P1: plain logging and <APP>_LOG_LEVEL fix
nodes.rationale: Precedence CLI > NEWSMERGER_LOG_LEVEL > config log_level > warning.

nodes.label: SQLAlchemy models never leave db.py; DTOs cross the boundary
nodes.norm_label: sqlalchemy models never leave db.py; dtos cross the boundary

nodes.label: Each protocol has its own method name
nodes.norm_label: each protocol has its own method name
nodes.rationale: foundation matches protocols with issubclass() which compares method names only; a shared run method made remixers load as processors.

nodes.label: Write lock (exclusive flock on <database>.lock)
nodes.rationale: Prevents two writers racing on content release; fails at once instead of waiting.

nodes.label: Reprocessing triggers (content change, version bump, force, deletion)
nodes.norm_label: reprocessing triggers (content change, version bump, force, deletion)
nodes.rationale: Config changes never regenerate anything; only explicit triggers do.

nodes.label: Processor dependencies via requires
nodes.rationale: Items waiting on upstream spend no attempts, so running processors out of order does not exhaust retries.
